result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active contributors. The change is one condition in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, in `getAllTeams()` (around line 747):

```java
if (!added[0] && contributor.getContributor().isActive() && !remainder.getMembers().contains(email)) {
```

- **Dormant unmatched contributors** are skipped and do not appear in "Undefined Team".
- **Configured teams** are unchanged. Their matching code runs before the remainder check, so their members stay in regardless of activity.
- **Blank latest-commit dates** count as active. `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for blank input, so `Contributor.isActive()` covers this without extra code.

I checked that `getAllContributors()` sets `latestCommitDate` on each `Contributor`, so the check has real data to read. `mvn -o -pl codeanalyzer test` ran with no failures or errors in the surefire reports. The module has no existing tests for team grouping, so the new behaviour is not covered by a test. I did not commit.
